rule: A reference amount, a recipe ingredient value and a retention factor are accepted by the server only when they match this file. Add a record here only after checking it against the official source.

IFCT 2017.release: Indian Food Composition Tables 2017, ICMR–National Institute of Nutrition (T. Longvah et al.)
IFCT 2017.transcription: npm ifct2017@2.1.2 (open transcription, AGPL-3.0; lookup only, never shipped in the app)
IFCT 2017.official_check: Per record (records[…].official_check). None done yet for IFCT records: the build workspace cannot download the official PDF (network allowlist), and the PDF text that can be read carries no table values (55,160 characters: front matter and chapter 1 only). The 19 Oct reviewer checked selected ragi entries and table headers against the PDF and found several pilot ingredient values match, but did not list which, so no record is marked. Values to check are listed in qa/nutrient-pilot-2k/README.md.
IFCT 2017.caveat: This open copy writes 0 for both "none" and "not analysed", so IFCT zeros are never pinned and never proposed. Check transcriptions against the official PDF; below-detection, not-analysed and recorded-zero distinctions in the printed table are preserved by not pinning ambiguous zeros.

USDA SR28.release: USDA National Nutrient Database for Standard Reference, Release 28 ("Version Current: September 2015", as cited in the package README). Whether this copy includes USDA’s May 2016 minor revision is not stated by the package and has not been verified.
USDA SR28.official_source: https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/ (published as "SR Legacy"; note: SR Legacy’s FINAL release is April 2018 and may differ from SR28 for some records — these extracts are SR28, named exactly)
USDA SR28.transcription: npm fda-nutrient-database@1.0.2, files ABBREV.txt and FOOD_DES.txt (SR28 ASCII release; lookup only, never shipped in the app)
USDA SR28.caveat: A blank in ABBREV means "not analysed" and is never pinned; a 0 is a measured value and is pinned as 0.
USDA SR28.official_check: Per record (records[…].official_check). Checked so far: 20445 (rice) against FoodData Central SR Legacy. The other 15 SR28 records are not checked: the FoodData Central demo key was rate-limited from the build workspace after two lookups.

Product label.release: Exact product labels, added one by one when a label is in hand
Product label.caveat: No label extracts are pinned yet, so no "Product label" reference amount can pass verification.

USDA SR28._other: other minerals and B vitamins: the ABBREV field of the same name, in the app unit

IFCT 2017._columns: IFCT 2017 component codes as transcribed in ifct2017@2.1.2 (check against the official PDF headers)
IFCT 2017.vit_d: chocal (cholecalciferol, D3) only, converted 1 mcg = 40 IU; ergocalciferol (D2) is not used
IFCT 2017._other: other nutrients: the component code mapped in ref.mjs IFCT_MAP, converted from g to the app unit

retention_factors_source: The retention-factor table in npm ifct2017@2.1.2 (retentionfactors/index.csv), attributed there to IFCT 2017; fraction kept per cooking method; key "<nutrient>|<method>". Not yet compared with the official book (retention_factors_check). An absent retention factor on an ingredient means the documented default 1 (nothing lost).
